description: Record that an agent is alive — call it each work cycle (right after hub_report, before the next hub_queue_wait) so MCP/headless agents show up in hub_presence the same way screen-scraped ones do, no human bridge needed. Overwrites this agent's one presence record; freshness is judged at read time from ttlMin (default 15min), the same pattern hub_claim uses. Also refreshes this node's published snapshot (presence.<node>.json) at most once every 5 minutes, so agents on OTHER nodes can see you at all — the directory itself is node-local and never syncs.

agent.description: your stable identity, e.g. your agent name

role.description: the queue role you work under, e.g. "hubd" — lets hub_brief pair queue depth with who is listening

silent_count.description: consecutive restarts of a model that produced no output

state.description: what the loop is doing, as a field a supervisor reads without parsing status: turn | waiting | exit. The hub keeps state_since — when this state began — across heartbeats that repeat it.

task_id.description: the task/id you are currently on, optional

ttlMin.description: minutes before this record counts as stale, default 15

turn.description: number of the current or last turn

turn_started.description: when the current turn began, or "now"; carried while the turn number stays the same

name: hub_heartbeat
